title: Forgetting scalars commutes with inverse image and its unit coefficients
statement: Let k be a field, a:Y to X a morphism over k, and f,g the structure morphisms with a composed with f equal to g [def-sc-field-linear-module-cohomology-operations]. Let U_X,U_Y forget k-actions, let L_k and L_ab be the scalar and abelian inverse-image functors, and let s_X,s_Y be the degree-zero integer-unit classes [new-sc-scalar-abelian-ext-factorization]. There exists a natural isomorphism c:L_k followed by U_Y isomorphic to U_X followed by L_ab. Precomposing the forgotten inverse scalar-unit isomorphism with s_Y and then the unit component of c equals the integer constant-sheaf comparison followed by L_ab(s_X). Moreover the forgotten scalarPullbackCoefficient followed by scalarHom of tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit [lem-weil-pbc-module-pullback-structure-sheaf] equals the component of c at the scalar structure sheaf followed by the abelian adjoint structure coefficient [def-sc-structure-sheaf-cohomology-pullback]. The first equation has degree zero; the second is a sheaf-morphism equation, and neither quantifies a positive-degree class.

source.place: Tag 01F7, functorial cohomology maps; Tag 0096, tensor inverse-image adjunction; official tag pages read on 2026-10-13

proof.text: Obtain the canonical comparison with its adjunction and integer-unit sheaf-map equations. Apply Ext.mk₀ to the integer-unit equation, use mk₀_homEquiv₀_apply, mapExactFunctor_mk₀ and mk₀_comp_mk₀ to obtain the degree-zero Ext equation.

For the coefficient equality, cancel the inverse component of c and apply injectivity of the abelian inverse-image adjunction. Its coherence identifies the left adjunct with the forgotten scalar adjunct, which scalar_structure_coefficient_adjunct identifies with a.c. The right adjunct is a.c by the defining homEquiv.symm formula for scalarAbelianStructureCoefficient.

theorem scalar_abelian_pullback_square (k : Type u) [Field k]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))
    (g : Y ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) (a : Y ⟶ X) (h : a ≫ f = g) :
    ∃ c : scalarInverseImage (k := k) a ⋙ scalarAbelianForget k Y ≅
        scalarAbelianForget k X ⋙ scalarAbelianInverseImage a,
      ((scalarAbelianUnitClass k Y).comp
        (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ ((scalarAbelianForget k Y).map (scalarInverseUnitIso a).inv))
        rfl).comp
          (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (c.hom.app (𝟙_ (KSheaf X k)))) rfl =
        (Abelian.Ext.mk₀ (scalarAbelianIntegerIso a).hom).comp
          ((scalarAbelianUnitClass k X).mapExactFunctor (scalarAbelianInverseImage a))
          rfl ∧
      (scalarAbelianForget k Y).map
          (scalarPullbackCoefficient f g a h (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf) ≫
            scalarHom g (tensorPullbackObjUnitToUnit a)) =
        c.hom.app (scalarSheaf f (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) ≫
          scalarAbelianStructureCoefficient a
